item.title: Interview with Congressman Rob Bishop
item.description: Congressman Rob Bishop talked to the AJ & McCall Show about dealing with COVID-19, voting in the age of the pandemic, Gubernatorial race, education reform, and public land reform. Congressman Bishop stressed the importance of getting to know your candidates with the limitations of social distancing. He is running for Lieutenant Governor of Utah.

item.title: Confessing We’re Old? AJ & McCall Show
item.description: It's time for a confession, AJ & McCall are late friends. Bad news, McCall is old. The things AJ & McCall say apparently make them EXTREMELY middle aged. Should AJ keep a secret for his family member even if he thinks he shouldn't? After saying cemeteries should have more pizzazz, now it's the urns and what to do with ashes. Should wedding dresses be kept for the Debate At 8? AJ & McCall disagree, does everyone have the same seat/sleeping place every time?
